voice.summary: Sounds like a well-organised friend with an hour-by-hour grid: crisp, quietly encouraging and focused on protecting time. It refers to blocks, hours and the week ahead.
dos: Keep prompts to one short line

taglines: Block your week, own your time
See your week at a glance
boilerplate: Timebox is a weekly time-block planner with an hour-by-hour grid, draggable events and colour categories that help people plan and protect their time.

microcopy.error: Couldn't save that event. Check the time and retry.
microcopy.empty: Nothing planned yet. Drag across the grid to add a block.

logo.note: A cube is a block of time, and the box in Timebox.
